title: Harrison Squared Dies Early
author: Daryl Gregory
description: A Lovecraftian choose-your-own-adventure through a creepy school. There's a monster on the loose, and  the only one who can track it down is you, Harrison Harrison, teenage monster detective. This is a companion game to the novel HARRISON SQUARED (by Daryl Gregory, Tor Publishing 2015), with text and puzzles by the author and art by David Hinnergardt.
